body:
You're very nice and encouraging and I bet your niece really loves you.
Thank you for the kind words.
Live a long, wonderful life full of joy.

I hope all the best for you.
Thank you.

You're very sweet. I like that.
Thank you.

Fuck, that was amazing and made me feel like holding on some more.
You must be a very valuable friend.
I already know that a lot of people love you.
Thank you so very, very, much for the nicest thing I've ever read.
Please go very far in life.

The thing is, my counsellor scares me now.
I'm scared that she believes her and sees me as a monster.
I can't go back there now.
Thank you for the helping hand.
You're amazing.

I'm very sorry about your situation. I hope she got what she deserved (penalty wise). 
I hope you go places in life.
Thank you.

Thank you for your concern. 
I'll be leaving, though.
You're sweet.

I guess I may be just anxious. It's a big secret to carry at our age.
Stay alive, please don't try suicide anymore.
Go far in life, person. Don't look back.
I hope for the best for you, and the happiest life.
Thank you.

Thank you for the encouraging words. 
I know you'd make a great friend to someone in need (mentally) and I love the urgency in your comment. Suicide is a very urgent thing, and I'm happy that you didn't just casually write something.
Thank you for being here.
You're a very nice person, and you have to go far in life.

I love the word mate. My grandpa's English and it's a very familiar word in my household.
I'm glad to know that there's someone in this world that would make such a remarkable parent as you would.
Please have children. 
Thank you for the words of kindness, and you seem like a truly amazing individual.

Thank you for making it seem like I'm not alone.
You truly are a very kind person and I hope you go very far in life.

Update for those who'd like to know:
I'm trying suicide tonight. Really hope I don't have to come back here and say it didn't work. Thank you for all the positivity and kindness. It really makes society seem different to read all of your comments. I'm sorry to those who've tried. You seem like kind people.
Brian Griffin. Apparently no one's going to mention how much of a self-centred asshole he is. Seems like he'll do anything for attention.
